$comment: Per-part movement vocabulary, expressed in the units of config/rom.v1.json. A move value is a SIGNED FRACTION of that DOF's typical range: +1.0 is the typical positive limit, -1.0 the typical negative one. A move therefore cannot name an out-of-range pose, and the constraint layer and the vocabulary cannot disagree. Generated from rom.v1.json; tests/test_body_part_moves.py fails if the two drift apart.

value_convention.units: fraction of the DOF's typical_deg range

left_grip_power.description: Acquire a free object. The thumb reaches opposition before the fingers close, because index and middle reaching the object first push it out of the hand.

left_release.description: Open every digit together; nothing to sequence.

left_wave.description: Arm up, forearm supinated, wrist alternating.

right_grip_power.description: Acquire a free object. The thumb reaches opposition before the fingers close, because index and middle reaching the object first push it out of the hand.

right_release.description: Open every digit together; nothing to sequence.

right_wave.description: Arm up, forearm supinated, wrist alternating.

left_grip_precision.description: Precision grasp: thumb pad to index pad. The other three stay clear -- a pinch that curls them is a power grasp with a smaller object in it.

right_grip_precision.description: Precision grasp: thumb pad to index pad. The other three stay clear -- a pinch that curls them is a power grasp with a smaller object in it.
